match.reason: The closest bank points cover access to services through distance, transport and internet, but none covers income or access to goods, which the new point requires, so a new point is needed.

draft.title: Access to goods and services
card: Access means being able to get a good or service when you need it. Not everyone has the same access.
Income matters because people need money to buy things. Distance and transport matter because a shop, clinic or school that is far away is harder to reach, especially with no car or public transport.
Internet access matters because many services, such as online learning, banking and streaming, need a connection. Slow or no internet can limit these.
Where people live affects all of these. Cities usually have more shops and services close by. Remote places often have fewer and further apart, so people may travel far or wait for deliveries.
draft.remember: Money, distance, transport, internet and location can all change what people are able to get.

a.q: Which of these is a reason a family on a remote farm may have less access to services?
opts: The nearest clinic and school are very far away
They live where many shops are close together
They can reach services quickly on public transport
They have the same choice of services as city people
a.why: A long distance to a clinic or school makes services harder to reach. The other options describe the easy access that is more common in cities.
a.clue: Think about how far people must travel.

b.q: Sam lives in a country town with a slow internet connection. Which service is he most likely to find hard to use?
opts: Online classes that need a strong connection
A local bakery in his town
A bus that runs past his house
A doctor visit in a nearby clinic
b.why: Online classes need a good connection, and Sam's is slow. The bakery, bus and clinic do not depend on the internet, so his slow connection does not limit them.
b.clue: Which service depends on the internet?

a.best: The nearest clinic and school are very far away

b.best: Online classes that need a strong connection

problems.detail: The right option is clearly the longest. It is the only one with a qualifying detail ('that need a strong connection'), which echoes 'slow internet connection' in the stem, so a student could pick it without knowing the idea. Shorten it to 'Online classes', or give the other options similar detail.
